details.pattern: Written: Paper I General Ability & Intelligence (250 marks, objective) + Paper II General Studies, Essay & Comprehension (200 marks, descriptive). Then PET/PST, medical, Interview (150 marks).
details.syllabus: GK, Reasoning, English, Essay, Comprehension, Security issues.
